assumption: Software components access the debouncing control via port interfaces such as DiagnosticMonitor.
rationale: SWS_Dem_00598 defines DiagnosticMonitor for modifying event information by SW-Cs, whereas SWS_Dem_00683 explicitly provides for SW-Cs as callers of the debouncing control as well.
